detailed_description: The Grouped Line Chart Generator helps you compare multiple trend lines on the same axes so changes over time or sequence are easy to read. It is useful when you want to show how several teams, products, channels, or scenarios move relative to one another instead of focusing on a single series. You can enter grouped data, adjust titles, colors, legends, and line options, then export the final chart as PNG or SVG after reviewing the live preview in the browser.
usage_steps: Add the labels, values, and series names you want to plot in the grouped line chart editor.
Set the chart title and confirm the line labels clearly identify each series.
Adjust colors, markers, legend visibility, and other display settings to improve contrast.
Check the preview to make sure the trend lines are easy to follow and the categories are in the right order.
Export the finished grouped line chart as PNG or SVG for reports, presentations, or product docs.
usage_examples: Compare monthly active users across several regions on a single timeline.
Show weekly sales trends for multiple product categories in one management update.
Track response time changes across environments after a rollout or infrastructure update.
